# raff_tag (Resource)

Manages an account tag. A tag is shared by every server that has it: a change shows on all of them. Link a tag to a firewall with `tag_ids` on `raff_security_group`. Needs the `account.tags.manage` permission (account Owner and Admin by default).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name, 1-40 characters, unique in the account ignoring case.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Tag colour: `gray` (default), `red`, `orange`, `amber`, `green`, `blue`, `violet` or `pink`.
- `priority` (Number) Priority 1-9, 1 highest. Leave it out for none.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `server_count` (Number) Servers with this tag, in the projects the API key can see.
- `updated_at` (String)
